source_audit.role: Immutable subset snapshot of source/engine questions at its audited revision, not current execution findings or another active plan.

scopes.title: Retain fixed-design repeated predictive conditioning
scopes.smallest_real_question: For unchanged training covariance/design/proper prior and future response/noise, can many original training vectors produce the same posterior mean and joint future density while preparing invariant factors once?
explicit_missing_prerequisites: A retained future-response/covariance owner and pooled per-training-vector operation do not exist. Freeze owner lifetime, borrowed/owned lineage, exact offsets, masks and cumulative admission/allocation/work rules.
Freeze a matched complete-preparation baseline and named output/error targets before optimizing.
scopes.smallest_reviewable_deliverable: One native retained repeated-conditioning consumer used by the existing generic and narrow-ladder campaigns; evaluate means/densities in a coarse batch without reassembling or refactoring fixed W for each realization.
independent_route: Compare every accepted/refused input and output against existing complete preparation at identical arithmetic, domains, target law and output masks.

Use existing original rational/Decimal facts plus independently constructed posterior/future references; test rank-deficient design, correlated prior/noise, exact-offset refusal, quotas and move/lifetime failures.

Instrument actual covariance assembly/factor/solve counts and observed allocations. Measure both arms at matched quality including setup, capture/retained output storage and actual attempted counts; do not predict a speedup from old timer scopes.
claim_exclusions: No observed held-out qualification, released-box target or new posterior model.
Fixed-truth shifted-prior coverage remains a biased estimator sampling target, distinct from prior-predictive credible coverage.

scopes.title: Normalize the explicit released fixed44 box target
scopes.smallest_real_question: For the pinned released-fixed44/v1 target, what is its normalization and one explicitly requested original-coordinate marginal in the 46-dimensional measure?
explicit_missing_prerequisites: No box-constrained optimizer, numerical normalization, posterior marginal, chain or evidence is implemented. A bounded actual46 integration/rectangle route and downstream error allocation must be chosen and independently checked.

Axis44 physical label and some compact reduction lineage remain unresolved; these do not invalidate the explicit mathematical fixed-point measure but block a physically qualified released H0 interpretation.
scopes.smallest_reviewable_deliverable: One source-fixed 46-measure normalized target, with Z and one declared marginal/credible quantity; preserve original bounds/row order/covariance and explicitly represent axis44 as a point mass.
independent_route: Analytic1D/2D truncated-Gaussian limits and original high-precision independent integration test support, boundaries, tails and normalization.
Compare two genuinely distinct algorithms on the actual46 target with frozen refinement/error diagnostics; centered quadratic/rectangle algebra sharing the design equation is declared ancestry.
Preserve all failed/refused attempts and unresolved accuracy; do not use rounded paper H0, a Gaussian-prior replacement or the helper constant log-prior as an expected posterior.
claim_exclusions: The source helper initialization/widths are bounds, not independently measured priors or posterior facts.
Numerical normalization alone does not resolve the source reductions or establish observed H0.

scopes.title: Propagate a supplied optical law through detector/censoring
scopes.smallest_real_question: For a bounded supplied joint transmission law, what is the joint count or censored-data probability after marginalizing the shared optical state?
explicit_missing_prerequisites: A state-resolved coarse consumer must use each conditional expected signal, not only its mean or covariance. Freeze any conditional count/read-noise independence across bands/exposures.
No measured optical-state masses or population distribution are qualified; restrict the first target to explicit synthetic states inside detector domains.
scopes.smallest_reviewable_deliverable: One two-state/two-band synthetic end-to-end SDK experiment, then only the minimal native composition required by that actual consumer; retain nondetections and all state failures.
independent_route: Exact finite-mixture sums and two-state Poisson limits check marginals, cross-band dependence and normalization.
Independent refined continuous read-noise density/CDF controls check censoring masses and selected-only denominator; retain zero-noise/threshold limits and no-drop failures.
claim_exclusions: No measured detector/passband qualification or source-population recovery.
Calibration population covariance is not added as independent detector noise.

scopes.title: Close released ladder axis and reduction identity
scopes.smallest_real_question: What source-supported meaning and reduction maps explain fixed axis44, the four failed primary photometry joins and the unresolved compact constraint summaries?
explicit_missing_prerequisites: A primary source locator and complete reduction explanation for original44; faithful join/reduction maps for each preserved discrepancy. No relabeling from numerical coincidence.
scopes.smallest_reviewable_deliverable: A source-axis/reduction dictionary with exact locators, successful mappings and explicitly unresolved rows; any repaired target is a separately identified variant.
independent_route: Independently extract table equations/column supports and repeat joins against exact source bytes and declared printed-decimal/binary32 rules.
Check dimensions/units and isolate row3210 without treating its algebraic decoupling as a physical label; retain all failed joins unchanged.
claim_exclusions: This is source identity closure, not a new fit or observed H0.

scopes.title: Qualify one ladder held-out dependence or model variant
scopes.smallest_real_question: Can one declared event/block be predicted after a source-supported removal/recalibration without reusing its training information?
explicit_missing_prerequisites: Resolved physical event/calibrator identities, alternative-selection/artificial-star uncertainty requirements, training/future cross-covariance and source-supported priors/relation variant.

The current predictive API assumes independent future noise and synthetic-control source semantics; correlated observational future noise or new estimator semantics need a separate contract after source closure.
scopes.smallest_reviewable_deliverable: One pinned held-out-event or relation/selection candidate with complete dependence ledger and only then a conditional predictive experiment for that declared candidate.
independent_route: Independent Schur-complement/full-joint integration checks for the actual declared training/future dependence; original source-removal/refit comparison.
Predictive checks retain every removed event and shared calibration parameter; distinguish proper-prior prior-predictive coverage from fixed-truth biased sampling.
claim_exclusions: A mean shift is not a random calibration draw or full systematic uncertainty.
Unknown cross-covariance cannot be set to zero.

scopes.title: Close SDSS physical-event and observer/velocity lineage
scopes.smallest_real_question: Which physical event, sky/frame and velocity-map transformation produces each selected source redshift pair?
explicit_missing_prerequisites: Physical-event deduplication independent of CID/light-curve identity, source coordinate/frame map, heliocentric/CMB/group conventions and exact velocity corrections.
scopes.smallest_reviewable_deliverable: One complete321-row event/frame/velocity ledger retaining all discrepancies; an unchanged conditional calculation remains separate from any source-derived corrected variant.
independent_route: Reconstruct corrections from primary source formulas and pinned velocity/group data through a separately authored coordinate/frame route.
Check observer limits and same-redshift twins; keep measured input versus fitted/corrected quantities separate and preserve original values.
claim_exclusions: The existing6093 comparisons do not reconstruct the velocity map, prove event independence or perform a SN fit.

scopes.title: Map one calibrated light curve to physical exposure units
scopes.smallest_real_question: Can one original calibrated light curve be compared with an exposure-integrated source prediction using its actual flux units, time scale and error model?
explicit_missing_prerequisites: Released pipeline FLUXCAL-to-physical flux convention, timing/epoch scale, observing-system response, flags/censoring/extraction and full uncertainty/calibration dependence.
scopes.smallest_reviewable_deliverable: One source-supported light curve/exposure adapter preserving all original measurements, units, flags and nondetections; expand only after a single-event contract closes.
independent_route: Independent dimensional photon/energy conversion and wavelength/frequency projection plus time-refinement controls.
Check source error/covariance construction against original pipeline records and synthetic injection/extraction only where its instrument model is explicit.
claim_exclusions: Agreement of FLUXCAL arrays is structural lineage, not physical flux/error qualification.
Historical HST optical response is not the SDSS instrument.
available_evidence: sources/legacy-inputs.json: released light curves require wider archive

scopes.title: Map measured calibration summaries to an optical-state law
scopes.smallest_real_question: What exact coordinate/filter mapping and calibrated response model relates the released102-axis offsets to the105-filter source claim and to a joint optical transmission law?
explicit_missing_prerequisites: Resolved102-versus105 coordinate/selection mapping; actual selected instrument response and source-supported correlated optical states with normalized probability masses.
A fitted magnitude-offset covariance is not by itself a physical transmission distribution; historical equal-time columns and nine scaled variants have no probability masses.
scopes.smallest_reviewable_deliverable: A filter-coordinate/calibration dependency ledger and one source-supported measured-law candidate; use existing finite-law propagation only if the law actually supplies its required states/masses.
independent_route: Independently reconstruct filter/offset relations from primary calibration products, preserving tiny source covariance asymmetry rather than silently symmetrizing.
Independent wavelength/frequency integration/refinement for a chosen response plus calibration likelihood/held-out calibration data where present.
claim_exclusions: No fabricated optical weights, random interpretations of systematic variants or substitution of HST response for SDSS.

scopes.title: Qualify one empirical temporal source template
scopes.smallest_real_question: Can one pinned empirical spectral-time template predict a declared observer exposure with its original phase, normalization and uncertainty conventions?
explicit_missing_prerequisites: Exact source/template version and units, training/calibration ancestry, source phase/epoch and spectral support, colour/extinction parameterization and template uncertainty/correlation. Located files are not decoded/qualified here.
scopes.smallest_reviewable_deliverable: One sourced template reader/contract and one single-event forward experiment with explicit support/model extrapolation rules.
independent_route: Independent time/wavelength versus time/frequency integration, constant/linear-time analytic limits and temporal/spectral refinement.
Compare source definitions and trained template predictions through a separate reference consumer with matched inputs and provenance; distinguish fitted epoch/normalization from measurements.
claim_exclusions: A zero-outside-support template is a declared source model, not recovered unobserved emission.
No posterior or source-population qualification from a single conditional flux prediction.
available_evidence: historical SALT2/SNANA templates: source reader required

scopes.title: Qualify one measured detector law
scopes.smallest_real_question: For one actual instrument/configuration, do measured dark/flat/science data support the stated arrival, quantum-efficiency, gain, read-noise and threshold law?
explicit_missing_prerequisites: A coherent decoded observing/reference configuration, pixel/PSF/background/extraction rules, wavelength response/QE, gain/read distributions, saturation/digitization if relevant and calibration uncertainties. Historical asset paths alone are not a camera measurement law.
scopes.smallest_reviewable_deliverable: One measured detector-characterization packet for a specified configuration, with only an evidence-supported native law/domain extension afterward.
independent_route: Independent dark/flat/photon-transfer characterization and held-out calibration frames, plus analytic moments and independent characteristic-function/density/CDF checks.
Retain rejected/saturated/nondetected pixels and expose law failures; separate empirical measurement mismatch from numerical failure.
claim_exclusions: No measured-camera or standards-compliance claim from synthetic recovery.
Quantum efficiency follows optical transmission and is applied once.

scopes.title: Qualify one thermal BAO compression
scopes.smallest_real_question: Are the released mean/covariance and estimator reductions valid under the exact thermal state and supplied-drag hypothesis used by the native ratio consumer?
explicit_missing_prerequisites: Source fiducial cosmology/template/reconstruction/window/scale cuts and compression applicability, exact statistic/units and row mapping; any cross-probe dependence must be resolved or left unknown.
Predicted physical drag needs NEXT16; using a supplied source-defined drag remains a distinct conditional hypothesis.
scopes.smallest_reviewable_deliverable: One theory/estimator compatibility audit plus an unchanged-input conditional density experiment; if invalid, identify the specific lower-level estimator consumer needed.
independent_route: Independent background/distance/ruler quadrature and cofactor density controls check numerics at fixed physical density mappings.
A separately sourced estimator/mock or original likelihood reconstruction checks compression validity; numerical agreement with compressed ratios alone cannot qualify it.
claim_exclusions: Thermal state is not interchangeable with massless supplied-drag LCDM or full Planck base LCDM.
Posterior summaries are not extra measurements.

G and atomic central-value uncertainty stay fixed/excluded unless a separately explicit supported input law/asset contract includes them; helium kinetics is absent.
scopes.smallest_reviewable_deliverable: One immutable supplied-law provenance/conditioning packet, not another implementation of already completed LTE moment propagation.
independent_route: Independent source/reduction audit checks law construction and dependence; original rational density and high-precision direct-charge references check each accepted state and full cross-row moments.
Refinement and no-drop controls preserve failed states and positive unresolved spread rather than fabricate zeros.
claim_exclusions: Independent marginal omega/Y/T distributions cannot be assumed from unknown dependence.
Conditional supplied abundance is not nuclear abundance prediction or helium history.

scopes.title: Predict a source-defined physical drag endpoint
scopes.smallest_real_question: Can a source-defined physical drag epoch be obtained from a qualified opacity/history rather than a supplied value or late-truncated unit-depth root?
explicit_missing_prerequisites: Qualified H/He ionization/rates and complete source-required late opacity history/boundary, exact drag criterion and frame/time definition. Currentzlate300–600 truncation changes the integral/root.
If the chosen endpoint demands residual ionization/reionization or a fuller multilevel treatment, it must be explicitly supplied/implemented and source-qualified.
scopes.smallest_reviewable_deliverable: One physical drag-epoch owner composed with the same retained thermal state and one downstream ruler error budget, separate from conditional truncated-root identity.
independent_route: Independent opacity integration/root algorithm, endpoint/tail-mass/refinement controls and source-defined physical reference with matched atomic/rate assumptions.
Propagate history/endpoint numerical diagnostics through the ruler; retain unresolved tails and boundary survival rather than renormalizing or zeroing them.

Separate held-out source/selection calibration data from fitted population summaries, with original parameter and survey-order lineage.

No nonlinear/light-cone, stellar evolution or radiative transfer closure supplied by these components.
